If the gates fail because the merged code is genuinely broken, fix the broken code or config directly on main.\n5. Re-run the failing checks and continue until they pass.\n6. Do NOT delete legitimate source code. Do NOT rewrite history. Do NOT discard legitimate merged work. Do NOT introduce unrelated refactors. Do NOT stop after describing the defect.
